name: Maximum raw logarithmic difference-to-sum ratio
definition: Choose an integer set A with 2 through 512 elements, all in [-1000000,1000000], to maximize ln(|A-A|)/ln(|A+A|). Both sets contain all results of ordered pairs; the cardinalities count distinct integers.
solution_format: An object with set, a list of distinct integer elements.
constraints: The set has 2 through 512 distinct elements.
Every element is an integer in [-1000000,1000000].
A+A={a+b : a,b in A}; every ordered pair, including diagonal pairs, is included before duplicate values are removed.
A-A={a-b : a,b in A}; every ordered pair, including diagonal pairs, is included before duplicate values are removed.
The objective is ln(|A-A|)/ln(|A+A|), using natural logarithms.
verification: The checker recomputes exact integer sum and difference sets and their cardinalities. It evaluates the logarithmic ratio with outward-rounded interval arithmetic and uses the lower endpoint as the conservative maximization objective.

source_review.definition: Maximize ln|A-A|/ln|A+A| for2..512 distinct integers in[-1000000,1000000]. This raw ratio differs from T012 normalized ratio. Root checked explicit ordering reversal with n8/s26/d25 and its separated two-copy extension n16/s78/d75; they rank oppositely under the two objectives.

source_review.independent_verification: Sorted all unordered-with-repetition sums and ordered differences, count value transitions. Independently enclose logarithms by exact rational atanh power series with110 terms and explicit geometric remainder; the resulting rational ratio enclosure lies inside every formal80-digit mpmath interval. No numerical sampling certificate.
source_review.open_status: Reviewed primary formula and subsequent experimental sources provide constructions, without a proof of maximum for this finite configuration. No global optimality or best-public absence claim inferred from a limited source search.
